task.description: Implement the fix per src/design/audit_chain_text_resource_id.md. Concrete deliverables: (1) Create migrations/1107_fix_audit_chain_text_resource_id.sql implementing the 4-step DDL outline from the design: DROP + CREATE OR REPLACE for bpm_audit_chain_canonical_payload and bpm_audit_compute_chain_hash (TEXT signatures), DROP + CREATE TRIGGER trg_bpm_audit_apply_chain_hash, and CREATE OR REPLACE for bpm_audit_apply_chain_hash body that wraps everything in BEGIN ... EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RAISE WARNING 'audit_chain_skip: %', SQLERRM; NEW.chain_hash := NULL; NEW.prev_chain_hash := NULL; RETURN NEW; END; — plus the pre-normalisation step that detects non-UTF-8 bytes and replaces with '<invalid-utf8:N>' for the hash input only (stored NEW.resource_id left as-is). (2) In migrations/GBL-081_iss103_audit_resource_id_text.sql, audit bpm_audit_resource_info dispatcher: every branch that does `src->>'id'::uuid` must be downgraded to `src->>'id'` (text passthrough). Document the change in a comment. (3) In tests/integration/helpers.zig TestHarness.deinit, add a best-effort pre-rollback sweep `DELETE FROM audit_entries WHERE tenant_id = ... AND resource_id LIKE '<invalid-utf8:%'` guarded by error.ServerError. (4) DO NOT create audit_chain_utf8_test.zig in this step — TEST-DESIGNER owns Step 4. (5) After migration file is written, run zig build migrate (must exit 0) and zig build (must exit 0). (6) Run lint_sql_param_types.py src tests — must exit 0. (7) Read templates/lego-catalog.md and only edit CUSTOM blocks. After all validations pass, commit on the feature branch with message 'fix(ISS-0122): audit chain hash accepts TEXT resource_id + non-UTF-8 resilience (GH #388)' and push.
acceptance_criteria: migrations/1107_fix_audit_chain_text_resource_id.sql exists with the design's 4 DDL operations
git commit -m 'fix(ISS-0122): audit chain hash accepts TEXT resource_id + non-UTF-8 resilience (GH #388)' is on the feature branch
git push origin feature/WF03-gh388-20260802 succeeds (check for '* [new branch]' or similar update line)

result.summary: Implemented ISS-0122 fix: created migrations/1107_fix_audit_chain_text_resource_id.sql (drops UUID+TEXT overloads of bpm_audit_chain_canonical_payload and bpm_audit_compute_chain_hash, recreates with TEXT resource_id and UTF-8 EXCEPTION guard that returns a zero-hash sentinel on encoding failure, replaces bpm_audit_apply_chain_hash trigger function with pre-normalisation step that substitutes <invalid-utf8:N> for non-UTF-8 bytes -- stored NEW.resource_id left untouched; trigger drop+create guarded by to_regclass("audit_entries") so migration is a no-op in public schema and applies correctly per-tenant where audit_entries lives); documented in GBL-081 dispatcher (all branches already use bare text passthrough, no ::uuid casts to downgrade -- added explanatory comment instead); added best-effort pre-rollback cleanup in tests/integration/helpers.zig TestHarness.deinit. Validated: zig build 0, zig build test 0, zig build migrate 0 (applied), lint_sql_param_types.py 0/0/0, error-set grep empty. Commit f260ff6 pushed to feature/WF03-gh388-20260802.
